topics.title: 卢克陪伴漂泊者直面创伤的疗愈支线
topics.detail: 玩家认为卢克以朋友和医生身份接住漂泊者的恐惧与救爱弥斯的压力；全程配音、糖果谈心、金色眼睛创伤及彼此扶持让该支线成为克制却有分量的情感高光。
quotes: i always thought there was something different about this segue quest, in a very good way though. seeing rover finally open up and share his own thoughts/pain with someone made me feel so relieved. it's not really a quest, more like a therapy session for both rover and us players at the same time. i really love this quest <3 like aemeath once said, "short as it was, but it mattered." <3 thank you and i hope you have fun in the next 3.x quests as well!

this quest is the first time rover became himself without our meddling , as he not have any option dialogue and all of his dialogue is voiced in this quest , we can feel all rover emotions in this quest either it is anger, impatience, sadness, fear about what else he have lost after his memories wiped, and even his worry about the plan to save aemeth and deal with aleph-1 when he open the stridergate to save her , because the chance of succes is really low here

36:24 every time i think about luuk seeing the golden eyes i want to tear up. in his showcase we see the trauma he has with ichor and with the gold color in general, and yet his most trusted friend has that exact color in his eyes. meaning he needs to face it every time he looks at rover, until it became a word of endearment ー golden boy. that’s my take 😭 this quest was amazing! finally we have a healthy relationship between friends caring about each other, and rover doesn’t need to act like a hero or hide anything. i’m happy i got to experience it again through your playthrough!

it was just the perfect segue! we were broken and we needed luuk just as much as rover did. you now, i'm the kind of player who would never use currencies to pull for a male but that doesn't mean i don't want them in the story of course. this? peak afterquest, peak therapy, peak doctor. there's only one that topped it and it's 3.3's segue, that one branded my very soul.

man, that conversation between luuk and rover was absolute peak. the background music, chase brown's insane voice acting... everything was perfect. he really made you feel the moment and all the emotional weight rover's been carrying. and then there's luuk, who genuinely felt like that bro you can always rely on when things get tough. for me, that was the best scene in the entire game. absolute cinema. 🎬

there was a time when rover stood by luke’s side, offering guidance and encouragement to help him through his darkest moments; today, luke has returned the favor. he is a true friend—not merely a doctor who treats the body, but one who heals the spirit as well. what makes the story both touching and amusing is that luke was originally tricked by rover into working at startros—a ploy to distract him from a suicidal pursuit of his enemies—only to discover that he had actually found his true home there.

i personally love the ending scene, where rover gets convinced to try one of luuk's candies. and as he does - he eases a little, and allows himself to ask luuk whether saving aemeath is even possible. almost like that candy actually works and helps 'keep the numbness at bay', allowing rover to spill his real worries. beautifully made scene, on of my fav in the entire game. 10/10 cried every single time 😭😭😭

luuk is the definition of a true homie, let's all be like luuk! giving more voiced lines to rover is by far one of kuro's biggests ws! chase brown and jane jackson nail every single delivery, be it the calm thoughts, the emotional outbursts, the casual dialogue, it gives us more of their performances and let us see more of rover's personality. is just so peak!

this quest is incredible. it wasn't flashy or action-packed or "omg peak" in a hype way, but it was still "omg peak" in its own subtle way and really pushed the story forward while dropping a ton of breadcrumbs for the future. 10/10

ah yess the therapy session segue with dr luuk. idk if you notice lusty but this segue is 100% voiced without any dialogue option to choose. this might be the first segue or quest that rover voice all of his/her line.
quote_translations: 我一直觉得这个同行任务有种特别而美好的感觉。看到漂泊者终于敞开心扉、分享痛苦让我很释然；这更像漂泊者和玩家共同的一次疗愈。我真的很喜欢，正如爱弥斯所说：虽短，却很重要。
这是漂泊者第一次在没有玩家干预时真正成为自己：没有对话选项，全部台词都有配音。我们能感到他的愤怒、不耐、悲伤、对失忆后还失去了什么的恐惧，以及对救爱弥斯和处理Aleph-1计划的担忧。
36:24 每次想到卢克看见金色眼睛就想哭。他对辉光和金色有创伤，却要在最信赖朋友眼中不断面对它，最终“金童”成了昵称。这任务太棒了，终于有健康的朋友互相关心，漂泊者也不必再逞强或隐瞒。
这是完美的同行任务！我们和漂泊者一样需要卢克。虽然我不抽男性角色，但当然希望他们出现在故事里；这是巅峰后日谈、巅峰疗愈、巅峰医生。
卢克与漂泊者的对话堪称巅峰。背景音乐、Chase Brown惊人的配音全都完美，承载了漂泊者累积的情绪；卢克也像困难时永远可靠的兄弟。这是我心中全游戏最佳场景，绝对电影级。
过去漂泊者在卢克最黑暗时给予指引和鼓励，如今卢克回报了这份帮助。他不仅医治身体，也治愈心灵；漂泊者曾用计让卢克留在星炬学院，反而让他在那里找到了真正的家。
我很喜欢结尾：漂泊者被说服尝了卢克的糖果，放松后终于问出能否救回爱弥斯，像糖果真的让他暂时摆脱麻木并吐露担忧。场景非常美，是我全游戏最爱的片段之一，每次都哭。
卢克就是真正的兄弟，大家都该像他一样！让漂泊者拥有更多全程配音台词是库洛最大的成功之一，Chase Brown和Jane Jackson把平静思考、情绪爆发及日常对白都演得极好。
这个任务太精彩了。它不炫目，也不是靠动作场面制造“巅峰”，但用克制的方式推进了故事，并为未来留下大量线索。10/10。
啊，是卢克医生的疗愈同行任务。不知道你是否注意到，这段全程都有配音且没有对话选项，可能是漂泊者第一次为所有台词完整配音。

topics.title: 鸣潮整体优化不足与画面负载失衡
topics.detail: 玩家认为版本持续堆叠高精度画面、粒子和环境物理，却未同步保证不同配置及主机平台的稳定性；即使中高端设备也出现卡顿、崩溃、加载延迟和降画质需求，部分玩家因此暂停或退出游戏。
quotes: as much as i love wuwa unfortunately i have to agree it's kinda horribly optimized. i respect the team's ability to bend unreal engine to create their fantastic visuals, but its clearly at the cost of the gameplay experience. i used to play on my acer gaming laptop long ago, used to be able to save it externally. used to be comfortable with the size. but every new patch it get larger and worst. i have a 4700 (because of mh wilds) and it still stutters in the open world or takes it time to load assets. feel like septimont was when it really started becoming a noticeable issue, and it's gone down hill ever since. i genuinely want to know how people even play this on mobile. its why i cringe at pro kuro people praising kuro for "stablising" the game. having a playable game with a smooth experience should be the default, not something you pat a company on the back for. its like congratulating a store for stacking the shelves. maybe kuro needs to invest in its own engine if it wants to keep up this visual fidelity because the direction their heading is clearly getting worst.

yeah the way the game runs now is its biggest and real issue. there is no reason to have stuttering and lag on my brand new ps5 that i bought to play this game when it released on the platform in 2.0... i love this game to death but it is bloated and unoptimized to hell. as much as i really do enjoy the new areas and think they are gorgeous, there is just too much stuff going on. it cant keep going like this. my game runs perfect in jinzhou and regunna, slows a tiny bit in septimont but in lahai roi and mengzhou its noticeably laggier and my fans spin a ton. kuro and a certain section of this community needs to know when enough is enough. we don't need a bunch of particles everywhere, bundles of leaves with their own physics lying around and random shit everywhere. i would take regunna level graphics any day if that means the game is actually playable on a piece of hardware made to play games...

when you play wuwa and only wuwa you often forget how bad it actually is but as soon as you launch another open world ... boy oh boy. i have a 9060xt 16gb and yeah it ain't the greatest card but i can play a lot of visually stunning games on it without an issue, the witcher 3, rdr2, cp2077, fh6 with rt on etc... with optimized* settings 1440p without an issue while wuwa is just refusing to be a good boy and reach the fps i should. on top of that i can't even be like "ok lemme me lower my res" cuz you can't. unless i lower my monitor res there's no way for me to drop from 1440p to 1080 lmao, why ? no one knows. *optimized means that i don't use the highest settings just for the sake of using the highest settings, too many settings eats up ressources for no reason while giving nothing in return. ill finish by saying that the whole industry doesn't focus hard enough on optimization because there is no limitations anymore, back then they had to fit games on cartridges and cd's and shit, now ? unlimited space, highest graphics possible even for shit that don't matter or simply eat fps while doing nothing, relying on fsr/dlss, frame gen and so on to reach decent fps and all that garbage. it's not a wuwa problem, it's an industry one. sure wuwa tries to fix it but while they fix one issue they introduce new ones every single time.

while the game isn't the worst on my pc, wuwa is also the only game in my library with this type of performance issues rtx 4070 32gb ram ryzen 7 7700 its a powerful pc, not the most you can get by way above the recommanded specs. that's the first issue : a big lie from kuro as they didn't update their recommanded specs try playing wuwa with the minimum specs , it's genuinely terrible. second : the lack of optimization even for powerful rig. it's not normal and they're only getting a pass because the game is genuinely good. ever since septimont, the game is very mixed on the performance. on ps5 it's basically impossible to navigate inside startoch academy or even septimont. it's not complete dogshit but for those with middle config, it's becming terrible. i'd rather they just stop improving the graphics for now and focus only on the performance until it's good. edit : you said a few wrong thins that needs to be pointed out. ue4 games don't have a reputation to run bad, it's ue5 who does. its important to note that there isn't much ue4 open world games too. the game is not primarly played on mobile, it's mostly on pc and mobile is just added. same thing goes for most of the recent gachas for obvious reasons (nte, endfield, zzz)

it's almost amazing that they introduce all these incredible physics and visual cinematics and *not one part* of their reviews before launching the patch is about playability between different ranges of pc specs.

quote_translations: 我很喜欢鸣潮，但不得不承认优化糟糕；优秀画面是以游戏体验为代价，每次更新体积更大、表现更差，开放世界仍会卡顿和加载缓慢。
游戏当前运行状态是最大问题；新PS5也不该卡顿。新区域虽漂亮，却塞了太多粒子、树叶物理等内容，我宁愿用黎那汐塔级画面换取可玩性。
只玩鸣潮时会忘记它有多差，一打开别的开放世界就很明显；9060XT能流畅运行多款大作，鸣潮却达不到应有帧率，还不能方便降低分辨率，修一个问题又带来新问题。
RTX 4070、32GB内存和Ryzen 7 7700远高于推荐配置仍遇到性能问题；官方推荐配置已失真，中配体验越来越差，应该暂停提升画面，先把性能修好。
他们加入惊艳物理和视觉演出，却在版本上线前的评测里完全不谈不同档次PC的可玩性，这几乎令人难以置信。
3.5上线后我对朋友说，等到10.0可能要量子电脑才能运行；游戏很美也很喜欢，但必须在某些地方降低负载。
请告诉他们把负载降下来，我们有人只有5帧，根本无法推进。
体积从约140GB降到七八十GB，但探索仍然卡顿，敌人延迟生成也很烦。
我已经不玩了，因为担心电脑卡顿；高硬件门槛正在把大量玩家挡在外面，即使在较富裕国家也是如此。
这游戏以频繁崩溃、Bug、卡顿、冻结和不听投诉的开发团队闻名；如果你还能享受，那也祝你开心。

最高配iPhone刚买十五天，开服前半年仍严重卡顿且越来越差，最终删除；这根本不像面向移动市场的游戏。
中端游戏手机配散热器仍不停卡顿，想玩却从不打开；社区只吹捧不谈问题，玩家最终会沉默离开。
拉海洛伊后PC带不动，换到Vivo V40仍卡；同一手机运行终末地却不卡，我不理解原因。
PS5在拉海洛伊后持续卡顿，探索加载慢、风扇狂转，却不能调画质，希望官方修复。
原神多年后仍能在同一部手机运行，最低画质也可玩；鸣潮做不到，绝区零移动端也很难跑。
我喜欢鸣潮的剧情、角色和战斗，却因没有最新硬件而完全无法玩；PS5和R5 3600加1660S电脑都不可玩，很难过。
我很喜欢鸣潮但买不起高配，GTX 1050遇到Boss或特效技能就频繁冻结，最终玩了一年后删除，因为连五分钟都无法顺畅运行。

topics.title: 版本内容设计割裂与游玩动力下降
topics.detail: 除技术问题外，玩家还批评3.5下半剧情和活动不足、探索过度自动化、内容受时间及任务进度限制；角色养成、卡池压力和旧角色弱化等设计让休闲或回归玩家感到像在“上班”，降低持续游玩意愿。
quotes: to be honest, i feel like it's even worse not having events when the exploration is streamlined this much. for most stuff, since the release of the motorcycle, you follow the main road and find it all. chests are in clusters, the collectibles are scattered across high places mostly and the rest of the map is quite literally empty. and it feels annoying to move around without the bike as well. the entire map is built around bike traversal, leaving lots of the map just empty and hollow. there is literally no point in exploration anymore if all you do is run to an icon on the map, find most of the relevant stuff around it and leave. the birds are the only exception for me and for those i have to use the motorcycle if i don't want to go crashout. tbh i hated lahai-roi for this aspect and i so hoped mengzhou would go back to the roots. it seems i was wrong

this patch has been lame as hell tbh, the story was a slow crawl, the events (especially godforsaken knock-off vampire survivors) are mostly boring reruns of events i didn't like in the first place, the one event that's good is time gated, map exploration is basically completely automated at this point so there's no reason to even navigate the new map, so on and so forth. this is the first time in over 400 hours of gameplay that i've been majorly losing motivation to bother playing the game when everything is boring as hell yet takes forever to complete.

i struggled getting into wutherwing waves, as i can only be a more casual player. i don’t mind playing on the lowest settings if i have too, but starting as a new player is just too overwhelming. they give us a 30 day banner to get a character from later versions. 30 days and you can lose the 50/50. it would be different if it didn’t have a time limit. then it’s actually doable. but for someone who can’t play every single day, it takes me about a month to just get enough for one 5 star. i couldn’t even get it. i don’t even what to talk about getting the weapon too.

heck no, if they put suisui's part in the second part it would've been garbage. you're saying put a purposeful powerup in the story without prior build up. that's a real dues ex machina. accidental powerups are fine with getting later information on how they're able to do so like for example main character subconciously able to do something then a teacher comes later on to teach them what it is and how to properly do it. that's a full on weapon handed off in the time of need if there's no build up. the best answer was they should've did suisui banner first and delayed the erover+yangyang 5* till part 2. it would've also properly fleshed out yangyang's section which would've fixed it's concentrated info dump issue.

iv also quit 8 months ago, i didn't like that its becoming more like work than a game, performance issues after septimone update is so freaking bad iwas playing 100+fps now it 45-60 like how ?, and i hate how characters walk its like meh, progress is locked behind quests u have to do long quests to move to another region, nah dude, i switched to zzz and never looked back, and when i tried to look back i found out that they killed the old characters jinshi, camellya etc... they all worthless "genshin over powering bs" so wuwa is ded for me.

i don't think is only the optimization. i would say is also the maps being story locked, if you are a new player, get new character and then you can't build them because you have to do the whole story to get to the map that has what the character needs.

as a gamer who plays for the story, i find it really unsatisfying that there’s no story content in the second half. on top of that, i’m having trouble completing certain side quests (on ps5), so i can’t even collect the rewards or have something—anything—to do. plus, the way the motorcycle flies around gets on my nerves so much that i don’t even enjoy exploring what is otherwise a truly beautiful area. so, for me, it’s been a three-week dry spell.

releasing maybe 16 hours of gameplay every version and then also timegating it is insane on top of the weekly mode and the events not even being that good to begin with unironically the only thing i look forward to these days is the story and endstate matrix
i was suprised not having second haf story . day ruined .

i feel like it would have been better if we were to experience rover's perspective first, be curious how rover got his electro powers and as a second main quest suisui would explain it as a storytel how she had convinced hsin to give him power or whatever that was, dont remember rn. this way players would have been hooked up till the second half of a patch with some sort of unexplained mystery and the whole 3.5 wouldnt feel awkward - but thats my perspective, feel free to have yours.
quote_translations: 说实话，在探索被简化到这种程度时，没有活动就更糟了。地图围绕摩托移动设计，大片区域空洞，探索只剩跑图标；我讨厌拉海洛伊这点，本以为蒙州会回归本源，结果我错了。
这个版本很烂：剧情推进慢，活动多是无聊复刻，好活动还被时间门槛限制，探索几乎自动化；玩了四百多小时以来，我第一次严重失去继续玩的动力。
作为休闲新玩家，三十天的新手角色池还会歪50/50；无法每天玩的人一个月才能攒一个五星，更别提武器，压力太大。
如果把穗穗部分放到下半会变成没有铺垫的机械降神；更好的做法是穗穗先上池，雷漂泊者和秧秧五星放下半，并补足秧秧的信息倾倒问题。
八个月前我已退游：游戏越来越像上班，性能暴跌，走路表现僵硬，区域和进度被长任务锁住，旧角色也被淘汰；转去绝区零后就没回头。
问题不只是优化，地图还被剧情锁住；新玩家抽到新角色也无法养成，必须先做完整剧情到达材料地图。
作为剧情玩家，下半没有剧情很不满足；PS5支线有问题，摩托探索也很烦。虽然区域漂亮，但对我来说已经三周内容荒。
每个版本可能只有十六小时玩法还要限时解锁，加上周常和质量一般的活动太离谱；现在只期待剧情和终末矩阵。
我很惊讶下半居然没有剧情，一天都毁了。
如果先体验漂泊者视角，再由穗穗解释雷系能力来源会更好，这样谜团能留到下半，整个3.5也不会显得尴尬。

there's actually a creator who explains the problem in depth: ryuuku sensei. the main issue isn't just bad optimization. the specific unreal engine 4 build has a single-thread cpu bottleneck, so wuthering waves can't fully utilize modern cpus in busy areas, causing stutter. the freezes when leaving cities are a separate issue caused by the v8 scripting engine's garbage collection. kuro is already migrating from v8 to c#, which should greatly reduce those freezes, but the ue4 cpu bottleneck is an engine limitation and much harder to fix. it wasn't very noticeable at launch, but as the game has grown larger and more complex, it's become more obvious. since it's a live service game with constant update deadlines, they can't just switch engines, so they're likely improving it gradually behind the scenes.

this issue has been brought up across reddit and x recently. the stutters in the new region are tied to real-time shader compilation and asset streaming in unreal engine 4. ​wuthering waves is heavily dependent on cpu l3 cache size. if your cpu has less than 64mb of l3 cache, it struggles with the dynamic shader processing and frame delivery, causing heavy micro-stutters. it smooths out after a few hours of gameplay once your local shader cache is built up. btw i'm not justifying or defending wuwa. the game's optimization is trash and it needs to be fixed asap. but i have faith in kuro hopefully they'll improve the game performance

i will answer for optimization problem. unreal engine 4 basically uses c++ and blueprint for runtime scripts, mechanical scripts and others. but kuro drastically changes ue4 and switches scripting to javascript. this is problematic for xbox and ps5, but why? because ps5 and xbox are natively c#. but moving to c# will also remain the same because basic ue4 is c++. so why doesn't kuro use c++? because of limitations. using c++ wouldn't allow kuro to provide ray tracing for wuthering waves and wouldn't be able to convert ue5 features to ue4. the next issue is drivers. xbox and ps driver updates depend on microsoft and sony. meanwhile on pc, when the driver update causes problems with the wuthering waves game, just downgrade the gpu driver. on mobile, the problem is in the runtime and script interpreter sections. natively, android supports c#, but ue4 uses c++ which makes the cpu translate back and forth. this can also happen in games that use unity, the reason is simple, because different driver versions, different devices, different android versions will also have different performance. so optimizing wuthering waves is a big challenge, especially now that it is migrating to c# so that xbox and ps5 can have better performance, but for android, this is a new problem. why is this a new problem? because the config that has been helping to address performance will be difficult to use again due to different scripts and different handling. so, it is difficult to set optimization to run on all devices because it is ue4 based. if you use ue5, this problem can be less severe because there is already optimization from epic. my advice, for those who have a pc device, just use a pc. for android users, use vulkan, if there is no vulkan setting, use config to enable vulkan. for xbox, wait for driver update from microsoft and wait for version 3.6 after wuthering waves full migration to c# scripting. why wuthering waves uses ue4 is because ue5 was still unstable at that time and wuthering waves was in progress. that's why kuro chose to modify ue4's structure using kuro's original script. so, ue4 in wuthering waves is the same as kuro's original engine with base ue4. as a mobile player, i can play wuthering waves smoothly on poco x3gt because i added my own script because the problem on poco x3gt is only in gpu bandwidth. so i maxed out all the mali g77 gpu cores as a solution to the bandwidth shortage.

i recommend a video from ryuuku sensei called "this is why wuwa feels unoptimized", he goes into a lot of detail. and to summarize, the issue is with unreal engine 4, because it processes stuff on a single cpu thread. this issue has been fixed in unreal engine 5. some people may have better performance on "lower" spec hardware, because their l3 cache on the cpu is bigger (which helps to more stabilize the game, less frame drops, meaning "more fps"). and also, because it's a cpu thing, changing graphics card to newer doesn't help as much (or maybe even in some cases doesn't help at all) as most people would think. and honestly, this is on kuro, because they planned to make a open world game, not on ue5, but ue4, knowing the engine's limitation (or atleast learn about it, which they had to moving from unity (pgr is a unity game)). and them porting stuff (like certain features) from ue5 to ue4 just suffocates the engine more. they would either have to rewrite the engine, or move the game to ue5. the fixes they have been doing do kinda help (but that still has a limit, because the issue is the engine), while also shoving more heavy stuff into, like all the environmental interactions they have been adding, or bigger areas with a lot of moving parts (and interactible). also checked the l3 cache of the cpus you used: 1. amd ryzen 5 3550h - 4 mb 2. amd ryzen 7 5700x - 32 mb 3. intel core i5 - 20 mb (intel's smart cache "technology") and in the video it does show the performance reflecting the l3 cache size, but idk what's happening with intel here, probably the way the cpu handles the l3 cache may be the problem, or how the engine handles intel's cpu.

i wish more people talked about wuwa's performance problems in depth, i mostly hear about the "wuwa stutters" "wuwa has bad performance" but it's hard to know the device specs that have these problems, and it's often answered with "just upgrade lol" which is stupid. it's scary to imagine how bad performance will be in 4.0 if kuro never adresses the performance problems, i feel like soon wuwa will require more ram and vram, it's already pushing the vram above 6gb in mengzhou. and cpu performance is worsening patch by patch. soon even ryzen 9950x3d2 will not be enough. wuwa became more demanding every major patch, but it got out of hand recently with how much performance dropped in the new regions even on the reatively strong hardware. 2.0: game became more cpu demanding, not by a lot, but in some areas it was very noticeable, i was playing with ryzen 2200g at the time, and in the center of ragunna city near the fountain fps dropped by a lot, everywhere else it was fine. 2.4: game became more gpu demanding, especially in certain areas. i upgraded to ryzen 5600 before 2.4, so i don't know how much cpu usage changed compared to 2.0. game is still perfectly playable aside of few stutters here and there in septimont. some stutters were fixed after a while. 3.0: game became noticeable more demanding on cpu and gpu, especially in star torch academy at night: very gpu heavy area, and fps drops by a lot; very cpu heavy when you just drive in a bike inside the academy, fps easily drops to 30 or even below. same for the fights, fps often drops to 40. 3.4: game becomes unplayable, constant crashes in dx12 with "device hung/removed", only dx11 or insane gpu underclock fixes it (no, it's not a gpu or overclock problem). and stutters, i saw more stutters than nonstutters in 3.4, when they start game constantly runs at 1-3 fps when you do anything. later i found out that wuwa starts unloading itself into a pagefile, which was on my hdd, hence the stutters, but i saw a lot of people with the same problem none of which had pagefile on hdd, and also this never was a problem before 3.4, so i blame the wuwa for this, especially that wuwa starts aggresively unloading itself from ram when not even 80% of ram is used, while nte runs perfectly smooth at 96% ram usage. i somehow managed to fix these massive stutters by enabling memory compression in windows and setting disablepagingexecutive in regedit to 1. minor stutters still remain from this game being very cpu bottlenecked. i'm speaking out of my experience, so for some people it might be different. my pc specs: cpu: ryzen 5600 gpu: rx 7600 (with underclock set at 2400mhz for wuwa and custom fan curve) ram: 16gb 1tb ssd (wuwa is on ssd) and 1tb hdd

the game has optimization issue yes. however: 1 - the game is capped at 60 fps out of the box. cards that exceed it can get a "bounce back" that lowers fps, however that depends heavily on the fps cap implementation. 2 - majority of the wuwa stuttering has been confirmed to be be scripting issue causing an overload on the game thread(ue thing), and has nothing to do with the gpu. the example where the video showed the stutter/freeze, he was loading in and out of an area that is populated by npcs. npc ai runs on that same thread and causes a freeze if you move too fast and load all of the people too fast. 3 - some settings hit harder than others. f.e. ue shadows switched from medium to high can delete roughly 40% of your fps, while providing negligible visual improvement. additionally, while using ray traced shadows, the raster shadow setting still impacts your vram usage, but does not affect the quality of the shadow. low turn off even the raytraced shadows, even if the setting is on, so best left on medium. 4- using any upscalers(dlss/fsr) invalidates fps benchmarks, since it relies on additional logic that determines how good of "gain" you can get from it. also upscalers perform poorly in high velocity situations, making them load the npu portion of the gpu more, trying to reconstruct the frame on time, which in turn can cause less fps. it sounds counter intuitive, because it is. also chromatic aberration, film grain and motion blur are a bane on any upscaler and make it harder for the image to be reconstructed, for which you pay with gpu power and fps too. this is constructive criticism. the game has issues. 90% of them are unreal engine issues.

kuro has made their bed with the decision to go forward with more heavier graphics, animations and in-game physics, rather than striking a balance with keeping the visuals at a constant level while improving upon optimizations. at this point arguing about what they should or should not do is pointless as they have already chosen the path that is going to bring in the most profits for them and we are no one to say anything about that. some will argue that wuwa's optimizations will obviously remain an issue by comparing it against genshin over their difference in visuals as a necessary sacrifice for being a far better game, when it has been repeatedly ignored by the same people that the hardware requirement for running the two games have been worlds apart in order to allow wuwa to run those graphics and animations in the first place. a quick rundown from epic games store where the recommended specs needed for running genshin at max settings comfortably, is lower than the mimimum required specs needed by wuwa to run at the lowest possible settings (and yet still remain a stuttering and crashing mess) should have already made it clear enough even back in the day that the two games have two different approaches. and now it seems people have forgotten but back in the day, wuwa devs stated that their mobile handle was actively holding them back from enabling more intensive features that can be run on pc but not on mobile, and this was in regards to the final fight against leviathan in septimont where devs wanted to implement the feature where the entire cast of characters battles alongside the player but they couldn't fully implement it solely due to mobile's limitations. the response from the player base back then should have made it abundantly clear that most players in wuwa community hardly care for optimization and would rather see it go under the bus in return for better and heavier graphics and animations. and this is supported by the fact that any dissent in the form of criticism regarding the game's optimization is met with insults and mockery. even more recently, wuwa devs stated in an announcement that they will continue to keep pushing the game to and beyond the limits of what technology allows, which was used by the wuwa community as an attack against the prior genshin dev's announcement that they were going to keep the playability of the game on older hardware and platforms as the priority over pushing for heavily modernising the game even if technology allowed to do so. this alone tells a lot about both the dev's and the player base's stance on optimization, hence any such promise of optimization and fixing the game should be taken lightly as it is more likely to be the case that where an acceptable level of performance is reached for higher end hardware to continue allowing the game to run newer and more intensive features, rather than be for the sake of making the game playable, let alone run smoothly for lower end hardware.

i'm just here to inform people that the main problem with wuthering waves is the cpu, not the gpu. most gacha games suffer from this to some degree (minus ake in my experience, to the point that i was able to play it on an hdd), but in wuwa it's far more noticeable because of the high-speed movement (flying, bike, grapple points, etc.) in open-world areas. look at the cpu usage in the video: wuwa is barely using ~30% of the cpu (sometimes a bit higher with luck). other games usually sit at a consistent 60-70%. this is a classic single-thread bottleneck. when you travel fast on the bike, the cpu has to constantly send instructions to the gpu about all the trees, textures, clouds, assets, etc. that need to be loaded. because the cpu can't keep up properly, the gpu ends up waiting for those instructions — that's why you get frame drops, stutters, and pop-ins. if you want to improve your experience in wuwa, upgrading the gpu is usually not the solution (not completely, unless you want to play on ultra settings and high resolutions). you need a stronger cpu, preferably a ryzen 7800x3d or higher (9800x3d, etc.) thanks to their huge l3 cache. low-end gpus can still work fine, but if the cpu is weak, the game falls behind and you get the stutters and pop-ins. the downside? x3d cpus need ddr5 ram (ideally 6000 mhz), and we all know how expensive ram is right now. side note: cyberpunk 2077 and rdr2 use their own in-house engines (redengine 4 and rage), so good performance is expected. look at other unreal engine games — stalker 2 (ue5) is open-world and is known as a very demanding game. even for ue4 open-world titles like ark, days gone, state of decay 2, and hogwarts legacy all suffer from stuttering and bottleneck issues. so yes, the problem is from the game, but this is a more in-depth look at why it happens. i really hope kuro finds a way to improve it... or somehow migrates to ue6 eventually, which seems to be aiming at fixing a lot of these cpu limitations.

to make anyone aware this video's conclusions are based on overlaying performance metrics from three friends' gameplay footages, all using completely different settings and setups. there is no controlled testing environment here. the creator's disclaimer claims the video is just to "spread awareness" despite admitting the results are not 100% accurate. how can you spread awareness using flawed data ? the initial testing shows gpu1 and gpu2 without saying which is external or explaining why the internal gpu (from cpu) wasn't disabled. meaning, both systems likely could've underperformed. there are simply too many variables. also video is constantly jumping between different settings and resolutions (not done in two tests each, on 1080p and 1440p). so, settings across different setups completely invalidates the comparison. to add, enabling rt on an rtx 4060 makes no sense, it's not rt capable card. the video keeps turning up rt shadows and global illumination in wuwa, while it being set to high as well, then video tries to "enable" rt in rdr2, a game that doesn't even have rt and then it is admitted with an oops saying it doesn't, yet keeps showing standard raster footage anyway. real rt reworks engine lighting entirely by tracing millions of light, colour, shadow rays per frame. if rdr2 magically had rt implemented, and it was set to high, both the 4060 and 3080 would tank 40–60% performance. requiring heavy upscaling and fg to remain pleasantly playable. the comparison is massively inaccurate.
